title: Nexus StrategyApproveRequest
description: Body of POST /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/approve. Approve freezes the candidate at `base_revision` only when the supplied trajectory equals the deterministic simulation of those exact bytes: the daemon recomputes validation and simulation over the stored candidate and refuses a missing or stale trajectory without writing a snapshot. The path `strategy_id` is authoritative.

base_revision.description: Candidate revision the client last read and simulated. A different stored revision is refused as `strategy_candidate_conflict` before any snapshot write.

trajectory.description: The complete `SimulationTrajectory` returned by Simulate for this candidate content, or null when no simulation exists. The daemon requires byte equality with the trajectory it recomputes over the same document; a different `ir_content_hash` is a stale-simulation refusal naming both hashes.
